rows.jp: 「ふう」
rows.en: “Phew.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Whew."

rows.jp: テーブルの上に、メモが置かれていた。
rows.en: There was a note on the table.

ghs.en: On the table was laid a memo.

rows.jp: 『夕食あるかも』
rows.en: “Maybe dinner.”

ghs.en: 『There's dinner perhaps』
ghs.assessment: The English memo retains Japanese corner brackets rather than the edition's English quotation treatment.
ghs.remedy: Use the established English styling for a written note.

rows.jp: 「わーい、行く行くー」
rows.en: “Yay! I’m coming, I’m coming!”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Weeee, I'm coming I'm comiiing!"

rows.jp: 自分で用意しないですんだ。
rows.en: That saved me from having to make anything myself.

ghs.en: I don't need to make it myself then.

rows.jp: 三分で着替えると、いそいそと彼女の家に向かうのだった。
rows.en: I changed in three minutes and eagerly headed over to her place.

ghs.en: I changed my clothes in three minutes then cheerfully headed towards her house.

rows.jp: 夕食は、おいしゅうございました。
rows.en: Dinner was exquisite.

ghs.en: 'Twas a most pleasingly delicious dinner.

rows.jp: 蝋燭に火をつける。
rows.en: I lit a candle.

ghs.en: I ignite a candle.

rows.jp: 独特の輝きが、室内を照らす。
rows.en: Its singular glow lit the room.

ghs.en: A very peculiar radiance illuminates the room.

rows.jp: 蝋燭が好きだった。
rows.en: I liked candles.

ghs.en: I loved candles.

rows.jp: 生の火に、強く惹かれた。
rows.en: I felt powerfully drawn to open flame.

ghs.en: Their raw flame captivated me so strongly.

rows.jp: こうしてぼんやりと揺らめく炎を見ていると、心が囚われて、いつまでもいつまでもまどろんでいることができた。
rows.en: As I watched the dimly flickering flame like this, it held me spellbound, and I could go on drowsing forever and ever.

ghs.en: When I looked at the flickering flame swaying so absentmindedly, my heart was enraptured and I could just doze off endlessly, endlessly.
ghs.assessment: ぼんやり describes the flame's dim, soft appearance or the viewer's hazy absorption. 'The flame swaying absentmindedly' assigns a human mental state to the flame.
ghs.remedy: Use 'As I gaze at the softly flickering flame...'

highlights.text: When I looked at the flickering flame swaying so absentmindedly, my heart was enraptured and I could just doze off endlessly, endlessly.

rows.jp: 以前、それで前髪を焦がしたこともある。
rows.en: Once, I had even singed my bangs that way.

ghs.en: Once, I even singed my bangs in it because of that.
ghs.assessment: One singes one's bangs on or over a flame, not 'in it.'
ghs.remedy: Use 'I once even singed my bangs on one.'

highlights.text: Once, I even singed my bangs in it because of that.

rows.jp: ぶっちゃけ三分前のことだ。
rows.en: To be perfectly honest, that was three minutes ago.

ghs.en: OK, that was like three minutes ago.

rows.jp: 「……焦げた……ちくせう」
rows.en: “...I singed it... Damn it.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...singed... dammit."

rows.jp: 泣きそう。
rows.en: I could cry.

ghs.en: It's to cry.
ghs.assessment: 泣きそう is the first-person reaction 'I could cry.' 'It's to cry' is ungrammatical and removes the experiencer.

rows.jp: とにかく日記だ。
rows.en: Anyway. Diary.

ghs.en: Anyway, to the diary.

rows.jp: 分厚い日記帳を開く。
rows.en: I opened the thick diary.

ghs.en: I open the thick diary book.

rows.jp: 人生の記録は、大切だよな。
rows.en: It’s important to keep a record of your life.

ghs.en: The records of life are really precious.

rows.jp: 学校に行った。
rows.en: Went to school.

ghs.en: I went to school.

rows.jp: 人がいないのにと思ったが、皆は来ていた。%N授業など行われるはずもないので、ぶらぶらした。
rows.en: I thought there would be no one there, but everyone had come.%NThere were obviously no classes, so I wandered around.

ghs.en: I believed that everyone would come, even if there were no people. Expectably, there were no classes held or anything, so I just hung out.

rows.jp: 冬子がやけにつんけんしていた。%N状況がつかめず、カリカリしているのだろう。
rows.en: Touko was especially prickly.%NShe probably could not get a handle on the situation and was on edge.

rows.jp: 屋上ではみみ先輩が部活。%N放棄されていたアンテナを組み立てていた。
rows.en: Mimi was up on the roof doing club work.%NShe was assembling the abandoned antenna.

rows.jp: 単純に据え置きで組み上がっていくものでもない。%N大変な作業だ。%Nけどその大変さが、先輩を救う。
rows.en: It is not something you can simply assemble in place.%NIt is hard work.%NBut that difficulty is what saves her.

rows.jp: 廊下を歩いていると、美希が掃除をしていた。%N先輩に部活があるように、美希には掃除があるのだろうか？%Nわからない。
rows.en: I saw Miki cleaning while I was walking through the halls.%NMaybe cleaning is to Miki what club activities are to Mimi?%NI do not know.

rows.jp: 人類滅亡という危機的状況が美希を覚醒させたのか。%N俺はとうとう美希に一本取られてしまった。%Nこれはゆゆしき問題ですぞ、校長！
rows.en: Did the crisis of human extinction awaken Miki?%NShe finally got one over on me.%NThis is a grave matter, Principal!

rows.jp: だが弟子が腕をあげたことは、素直に嬉しい。%N師である俺が抜かれる日は近い。
rows.en: But honestly, I am happy my pupil has improved.%NThe day she surpasses her teacher is not far off.

rows.jp: 他にもいろいろとあったが、全体的に良い日だった。
rows.en: All kinds of other things happened, but it was a good day overall.
